# Proxy Sentry CSV 1.8.22

## Faster proxy checks

- Unreachable proxy ports stop the check immediately after refusal or after a 3-second TCP timeout, without an extra HTTP attempt.
- HTTP response timeout reduced from 20 to 10 seconds.
- Check All runs up to 8 checks in parallel instead of 4.
- Failed checks no longer trigger a region lookup. Supplemental region lookup has a separate 4-second budget.
- A reachable TCP port with no HTTP response is reported as a response timeout, not proof of a dead proxy. HTTP 403/429 remain distinct from transport failures.

## Firefox and usability fixes

- Fixed Firefox grid alignment when the visible window belongs to a child of the Windows launcher process.
- Wait for browser windows to become ready; alignment failures are reported instead of silently skipped.
- Added Settings options for System / Light / Dark application theme and an optional path to firefox.exe. Both persist between launches.
- Browser profiles remain isolated per proxy; the personal Firefox profile is not imported or modified.
- Favorites list saving catches file-picker/write errors and prevents concurrent save dialogs.
- CSV is written through a temporary file so a failed overwrite preserves the original. Settings write failures show an error instead of escaping the UI handler.

## Verification

- 39 local regression tests passed.
- Visible Firefox windows were tested for grid placement, mirrored clicks, input, scrolling, form submission, navigation, and sync restart against a local fixture page.
- Extract the portable ZIP and run Proxy Sentry CSV.exe, or use Check updates in the application. User Data is not included in the release archive.
